name: headache-tracker
description: Simple headache tracker PWA/Android app with on-device storage and local reminders.

scripts.sync:web: mkdir -p www/icons && cp index.html app.js styles.css manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -r icons/. www/icons/ && cp .nojekyll www/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync android
